result.summary: The overall layout is coherent, but the bottom navigation bar is missing an icon for one tab and there are inconsistencies in the favorite-button styling and one card thumbnail.

issues.description: In the bottom tab bar, the 'Orders' tab has only a text label with no icon above it, while Home, Search and Profile all have icons. This makes the label sit lower/misaligned relative to the other tabs and breaks visual rhythm.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing Orders icon (e.g. receipt/bag glyph) so all four tabs have icon + label and share the same vertical alignment.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different styles: the Tokumaru Ramen card has a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below has a dark/transparent circle with a white heart, which reduces contrast and consistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button to a single treatment (e.g. semi-opaque white circle with dark heart) across all cards to ensure consistent appearance and adequate contrast over any image.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail in the 'Fastest near you' carousel has a light gray gradient background that looks like a placeholder, contrasting sharply with the dark, photographic-looking thumbnails of the adjacent cards.
issues.suggestion: Use a real image or apply the same dark background/overlay treatment so all carousel thumbnails look consistent; also verify the delivery-time badge remains legible on the light background.
